page.overview:
Who is Drake Thunderbrand?

Elementalist Drake Thunderbrand is a dwarven wizard and friend of Allura Vysoren, as well as a member of the Arcana Pansophical. As an NPC, he is played by Matthew Mercer.

Drake has short, black hair with a beard "trimmed fairly fine." When he first encountered Vox Machina in late 810 PD, he was wearing red leathers and was apparently unarmed, though carrying a gnarled, curved wand. The wand almost spiraled, in a messed-up sort of way, with a well-treated surface.

Somewhat exuberant in personality, Drake can also be quite soft—both concerned and supportive—toward Lady Allura.

Drake Thunderbrand is one of the eldest of House Thunderbrand in Kraghammer.
